item.tib: dbal gshen stag la yi thugs kyi brnag pa las dun rtse'i gshed ma'i rgyud sgrol byed mtshon 'khor
item.coloph: ces pa yab sras thugs sgrub las tshogs 'di yang mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas dben gnas ma d+hAl ri khrod du/ kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la snyan du brgyud cing gtan la phab pa'o//
